text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... *pant*... *huffff*... 
*wheeeze*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while watching the horse girls 
train, I heard a mysterious voice coming 
from somewhere. When I went over to check 
it out...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi was collapsed at the 
edge of the track...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Fuhaa... fuhiii... I-I'm sorry... I'm 
okay...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *wheeze*... I tried a different 
kind of training than usual, and...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Yes. You see, everyone in my 
class is just packed with so much amazing 
talent.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So I thought if I want to catch up to 
them, staying as I am right now just won't 
cut it...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I decided I'd try doing the same training 
that everyone else is doing!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Like Spe-chan's straightaway sprints, 
surging all at once from the back!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Like El-chan's uphill dashes to strengthen 
her lower body!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Like Sei-chan's long-distance running to 
build up stamina!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
And... after copying all that, I ended up 
collapsing flat on my face... Boo-hoo~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...I've always been like this, ever since 
I was little.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I push myself, my body can't keep 
up. There are so many things I can't do 
like normal people...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seems downhearted about her 
constitution. I should give her some words 
of encouragement—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: All righty!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If there's something I can't do, I'll just 
work at it until I can! I'm just going to 
go for it, I thought!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
My body might need a bit more work, but in 
terms of spirit, I won't lose to anyone 
out there!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her bright expression, free of any 
pessimism, truly reflects the strength of 
her spirit.
choice_data_list:
Yeah! I'm sure you have strengths uniquely 
your own!

Yeah! I'm sure you have strengths uniquely 
your own!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ! Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hearing you cheer me on gives me a surge 
of power! I'm gonna push myself even 
harderーー!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!? *cough*! *cough*! *cough*!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I-I choked on my own spit...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, thank you so much for everything! 
I'll definitely discover where my 
strengths lie!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While there are certainly things to worry 
about, seeing her sprint off so cheerfully 
makes me hold high hopes for her.
